resources.string: What should Mika learn? One sentence.

Steps stay on this phone, and only after you tap Start demonstration. If a model is set up, generating a skill sends a redacted summary of the goal and steps to that model. Passwords, verification codes and payment details are left out. If no model is set up, the draft is written on this phone and nothing is uploaded. The draft is not used until you accept it, and it has not been trial-run.
Mika will watch and will not operate the phone. You can pause, finish or discard. Nothing is recorded until you tap Start demonstration.
Discard this demonstration and delete the saved steps?
A task is running. Wait until it finishes before teaching.
Turn on accessibility before demonstrating. Mika cannot see taps without it.
Demonstration stopped because the app restarted or accessibility turned off. Nothing is recorded until you tap Resume.
That goal looks like a password or code, so it was not saved.
Could not write the draft. The steps are still here.
A draft is waiting in Memory and skills. It is not used until you accept it, and it has not been trial-run.
Mika is learning from you, so this task was not started.
Not enough interface information. This is not a coordinate action.
Mika is not operating the phone.
The Learning bar could not be shown, so recording did not start. Notification permission is not required. The accessibility overlay has to be visible, with Pause and Finish on it.
The Learning bar disappeared, so the demonstration stopped. Nothing more is being recorded.
